scope: Organism-independent synthetic regression validation; inaccessible server cohort and Parsnp matrices were not evaluated. No simulated noisy ONT challenge was run.
baseline: Saved working source immediately before this sweep, including the preceding reference-flank calibration change; this is not an unmodified release.
method: Alternating serial fresh processes, identical input bytes. Wall time excludes imports. RSS is max(parent, largest child), not concurrent total. Synthetic expected alleles are specified independently of caller agreement. Preparation is excluded from timing. All outputs and disagreements are retained.

challenge_metrics.note: Mixture counts are scored against either known allele. Missing calls fail all-locus exact accuracy; their absolute error is undefined. Absent loci have no truth allele: numerical completion is separate from observed presence. Calibration is descriptive on this small synthetic set, not validation.
